tuyen-sinh-lam-son-2024.title: Lam Son Entrance Exam 2024
tuyen-sinh-lam-son-2024.statement: Given two positive integers a and b. Count the numbers in [a, b] whose number of positive divisors is prime.
tuyen-sinh-lam-son-2024.input_format: The first line contains t, the number of test cases. Each of the next t lines contains two positive integers a and b.
tuyen-sinh-lam-son-2024.output_format: Print t lines, each containing the answer for one test case.
tuyen-sinh-lam-son-2024.explanation: A number is counted if its number of positive divisors is prime. In [2, 7], the numbers 2, 3, 4, 5, and 7 have 2, 2, 3, 2, and 2 divisors, respectively. The answer is 5.

chu-vi-dien-tich-hcn.title: Rectangle Perimeter and Area
chu-vi-dien-tich-hcn.statement:
Given the length d and width r of a rectangle. Calculate and print its perimeter and area.

Requirement: Use a 32-bit integer type (int in C++).
chu-vi-dien-tich-hcn.input_format: One line contains two positive integers d and r separated by whitespace.
chu-vi-dien-tich-hcn.output_format:
Line 1: the rectangle's perimeter.
Line 2: the rectangle's area.

chia-banh-32bit.title: Sharing Cakes - Integer Division and Remainder
chia-banh-32bit.statement:
There are n cakes to be shared equally among k friends. Determine how many cakes each friend receives and how many remain.

Requirement: Use a 32-bit integer type (int in C++).
chia-banh-32bit.input_format: One line contains two positive integers n and k separated by whitespace.
chia-banh-32bit.output_format:
Line 1: the number of cakes each friend receives.
Line 2: the number of remaining cakes.
chia-banh-32bit.explanation: Each friend receives 14 / 3 = 4 cakes. The remainder is 14 % 3 = 2.

mua-vo-32bit.title: Buying Notebooks
mua-vo-32bit.statement:
Given the number of notebooks and the price of one notebook, calculate the total amount to be paid.

Requirement: Use a 32-bit integer type (int in C++).
mua-vo-32bit.input_format: One line contains two positive integers n and price separated by whitespace.
mua-vo-32bit.output_format: Print the total amount to be paid.

kiem-tra-chan-le-32bit.title: Check Whether a Large Integer Is Even or Odd
kiem-tra-chan-le-32bit.statement:
Given an integer n, determine whether n is even or odd. Print EVEN if n is even and ODD otherwise.

Requirement: Use a 64-bit integer type (long long in C++).
kiem-tra-chan-le-32bit.input_format: One line contains an integer n (-10^18 <= n <= 10^18).

tong-thi-sinh-18-10-32bit.title: Total Number of Tmath Contestants
tong-thi-sinh-18-10-32bit.statement:
The Tmath Math and Informatics Center organizes an entrance exam on October 18. Given the numbers of students in groups A, B, and C, calculate the total number of contestants.

Requirement: Use a 32-bit integer type (int in C++).
tong-thi-sinh-18-10-32bit.input_format:
Line 1 contains integer A.
Line 2 contains integer B.
Line 3 contains integer C.
tong-thi-sinh-18-10-32bit.output_format: Print the total number of contestants.

so-sanh-hai-so-64bit.title: Compare Two Large Integers
so-sanh-hai-so-64bit.statement:
Given two integers a and b, find and print the larger one. If they are equal, print that value.

Requirement: Use a 64-bit integer type (long long in C++).
so-sanh-hai-so-64bit.input_format: One line contains two integers a and b (-10^18 <= a, b <= 10^18).
so-sanh-hai-so-64bit.output_format: Print the larger of the two integers.

tổng-tích.title: Sum and Product of Two Integers
tổng-tích.statement:
Given two integers a and b, read them from input. Print their sum a + b on the first line and their product a * b on the second line.

Requirement: Use a 32-bit integer type (int in C++).
tổng-tích.input_format: One line contains two integers a and b (-1000 <= a, b <= 1000).
tổng-tích.output_format:
Line 1: the sum a + b.
Line 2: the product a * b.

ve-phim-64.title: Cinema Ticket
ve-phim-64.statement:
A cinema offers a promotion: customers under 12 pay 50,000 VND; all other customers pay 80,000 VND. Given a customer's age, calculate the ticket price.

Requirement: Use a 64-bit integer type (long long in C++).
ve-phim-64.input_format: One line contains an integer t, the customer's age.

xe-32.title: Parking Fee
xe-32.statement:
Given the number of hours a vehicle is parked. If the parking time is at most 2 hours, the fee is 5,000 VND; otherwise, the fee is 10,000 VND. Print the amount to pay.

Requirement: Use a 32-bit integer type (int in C++).
xe-32.input_format: One line contains an integer n, the number of parking hours.

for cơ bản.title: Sum from 1 to n
for cơ bản.statement:
Given a positive integer n, calculate and print S = 1 + 2 + ... + n.

Requirement: Use a 64-bit integer type (long long in C++).
for cơ bản.input_format: One line contains a positive integer n.
for cơ bản.output_format: Print the sum of the integers from 1 to n.

hsg9-ninh-binh-2026-hinh-chu-nhat.title: Ninh Binh Grade 9 Excellent Student Exam 2026 - Rectangle
hsg9-ninh-binh-2026-hinh-chu-nhat.statement:
Given four positive integers a, b, c, and d. The numbers a and b are the side lengths of the first rectangle; c and d are the side lengths of the second rectangle.

Task: Calculate both rectangle areas and output the larger area.
hsg9-ninh-binh-2026-hinh-chu-nhat.input_format: Four positive integers a, b, c, and d (1 <= a, b, c, d <= 10^9).
hsg9-ninh-binh-2026-hinh-chu-nhat.output_format: Print the maximum of the two rectangle areas.
hsg9-ninh-binh-2026-hinh-chu-nhat.explanation: The first rectangle has area a * b. The second has area c * d. The answer is the larger value. For example, 2 * 4 = 8 and 3 * 6 = 18, so the answer is 18.

Ninh Binh-Câu 2.title: Ninh Binh Grade 9 Excellent Student Exam 2026 - Special Numbers
Ninh Binh-Câu 2.statement:
A number is special if it is divisible by the product of its digits. For example, 5 is special because it is divisible by 5; 12 is special because 12 is divisible by 1 * 2 = 2; 102 is not special because its digit product is 0.

Given an array A of n positive integers a1, a2, ..., an and two positive integers l and r.

Task: List the special numbers, in their original order, among a_l, a_(l+1), ..., a_r.
Ninh Binh-Câu 2.input_format:
The first line contains n, l, r (1 <= n <= 10^5; 1 <= l <= r <= n).
The second line contains n positive integers a1, a2, ..., an (ai <= 10^9).
Ninh Binh-Câu 2.output_format: Print one line containing all special numbers found, separated by spaces. If none are found, print -1.
Ninh Binh-Câu 2.explanation: Consider positions 2 through 5: 12, 15, 20, 5. The numbers 12, 15, and 5 are divisible by their digit products. The digit product of 20 is 0, so it is not special. The answer is 12 15 5.

Ninh Binh-Câu 3.title: Ninh Binh Grade 9 Excellent Student Exam 2026 - Counting Prime Numbers
Ninh Binh-Câu 3.statement:
During a Robot programming contest, An receives a signal string S of at most 3 * 10^6 characters. It contains only lowercase English letters and digits and is transmitted over the Internet.

An must extract numbers from this signal and count how many are prime. Each extracted number is a maximal contiguous sequence of digits whose preceding or following character, if present, is a letter. Every extracted number is at most 10^6.

Task: Count the prime numbers extracted from S.
Ninh Binh-Câu 3.input_format: One string S containing lowercase English letters and digits, with length at most 3 * 10^6. Every extracted number is at most 10^6.
Ninh Binh-Câu 3.output_format: Print the number of prime numbers extracted from S.
Ninh Binh-Câu 3.explanation: The extracted numbers are 2, 17, and 18. The numbers 2 and 17 are prime, while 18 is not. The answer is 2.

Ninh Binh-Câu 5.title: Ninh Binh Grade 9 Excellent Student Exam 2026 - Near-Perfect-Square Numbers
Ninh Binh-Câu 5.statement:
A natural number is a Near-Perfect-Square Number if it satisfies all three conditions:

- It has at least 3 digits.
- Its leading digit is a perfect square.
- The sum of its last two digits (tens and units) is a perfect square.

Task: Given a positive integer M, count the Near-Perfect-Square Numbers from 1 to M.
Ninh Binh-Câu 5.output_format: Print one integer: the number of qualifying Near-Perfect-Square Numbers.
Ninh Binh-Câu 5.explanation: For M = 105, the qualifying numbers are 100, 101, and 104. Their leading digit is 1. The sums of their last two digits are 0, 1, and 4, all perfect squares.

Ninh Binh-Câu 4.title: Ninh Binh Grade 9 Excellent Student Exam 2026 - Split the Array
Ninh Binh-Câu 4.statement:
Given an array A of n non-negative integers. Partition the entire array into non-empty contiguous segments so that the sum of each segment is a power of 2 (1, 2, 4, 8, ...).

Task: Find the minimum possible number of segments. If no valid partition exists, print -1.
Ninh Binh-Câu 4.input_format:
Line 1 contains a positive integer n (1 <= n <= 2000).
Line 2 contains n integers ai (0 <= ai <= 20000).
Ninh Binh-Câu 4.output_format: Print the minimum number of segments, or -1 if no valid partition exists.
Ninh Binh-Câu 4.explanation: One valid partition is {5, 3}, {1, 1}, {1, 3}, with segment sums 8, 2, and 4. It is impossible to use fewer than 3 segments.
